cmath_10805.hint:
## strategy
- concept: Intersection of Solution Sets
  description: Determine the final solution set by finding the overlap of multiple independent constraints.
  cues:
    - problem specifies multiple conditions that must all hold
    - individual conditions define separate intervals or sets
    - final answer requires satisfying all conditions simultaneously
    - Problem specifies congruences with the same remainder variable.
    - Conditions must hold simultaneously for the same $n$.
- concept: Casework by Residue Class
  description: Exhaustively check all residue classes modulo the period to count valid instances.
  cues:
    - Period is small enough to enumerate manually
    - Conditions are defined by modular arithmetic
- concept: Integer Interval Counting
  description: Calculate the number of integers within a closed interval defined by real bounds.
  cues:
    - problem asks for the count of integers satisfying an inequality
    - bounds are real numbers defining a continuous interval
    - target is the cardinality of the integer set within the bounds
